properties.NAME: WAYNE (N.W. Terr.)
properties.CHANGE: WAYNE (Northwest Territory, extinct) lost to Indiana Territory when Indiana Territory was created from the Northwest Territory. The eastern half of Michigan remained part of WAYNE (Northwest Territory, extinct).
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 3:86-88; U.S. Stat., vol. 2, ch. 41 [1800]/pp. 58-59)
